meta.title: 80%的人画口红显老｜3D立体唇画法
meta.title_en: Why 80% of People Look Older in Lipstick | The 3D Lip Method

scenes.title_en: The Problem: Direct Application and Smacking Age You
scenes.context: 化口红时直接涂抹在嘴巴上，再晕开、抿一抿，就会发觉口红容易掉色、唇纹更严重，远看整个妆容容易显老。遮住口红这个妆显年轻，一放开立刻显老十岁。语域：化妆教学，痛点引入。
sentences: 直接涂抹再抿一抿，口红容易掉色。
Smearing it on and smacking your lips makes the color fade fast.
smacking your lips（抿一抿）
唇纹更严重，远看容易显老。
Lip lines deepen and the look reads older from afar.
reads older（显老）
一放开口红，立刻显老十岁。
The moment it's revealed, you look ten years older.
you look ten years older（显老十岁）
paraphrase: 抿嘴 → smack your lips / press the lips
显老 → read older / age you
scenes.speak: Smearing it on and smacking your lips makes the color fade fast. Lip lines deepen and the look reads older from afar. The moment it's revealed, you look ten years older.

scenes.context: 先用润唇膏润唇，解决死皮和细纹。等待一分钟，用棉签把死皮揉开，抿一抿充分滋润。再用纸巾把多余膏体衬掉，后续上口红才能巴得住，否则会糊在一起变成一坨。语域：化妆教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: 先用润唇膏，解决死皮和细纹。
Start with lip balm to tackle flakes and fine lines.
flakes and fine lines（死皮和细纹）
等一分钟，用棉签把死皮揉开。
Wait a minute, then rub off the flakes with a cotton swab.
rub off the flakes（揉开死皮）
用纸巾衬掉多余膏体，口红才巴得住。
Blot the excess balm with a tissue so the lipstick grips.
blot the excess（衬掉多余的）
scenes.speak: Start with lip balm to tackle flakes and fine lines. Wait a minute, then rub off the flakes with a cotton swab. Blot the excess balm with a tissue so the lipstick grips.

scenes.title_cn: 第二步：遮唇线+腮红定妆
scenes.title_en: Step Two: Conceal the Lip Line and Set With Blush
scenes.context: 遮盖嘴巴边缘的唇线：用肤色的遮瑕膏，小刷子取一点粉，在手先过渡，沿唇线薄薄铺上去，用擦的方式让粉变薄，千万不要按压否则粉厚像上皮擦。接着用腮红在唇线边缘定妆，后续不会脱妆。语域：化妆教学，手法讲解。
sentences: 用肤色遮瑕膏，遮盖唇线。
Conceal the lip line with a skin-toned corrector.
skin-toned corrector（肤色遮瑕膏）
用擦的方式让粉变薄，不要按压。
Sweep the powder on thin — never press it on.
never press it on（不要按压）
用腮红定妆，后续不脱妆。
Set the edge with blush so it never wears off.
never wears off（不脱妆）
paraphrase: 薄薄铺上去 → sweep on thin / a whisper of product
scenes.speak: Conceal the lip line with a skin-toned corrector. Sweep the powder on thin — never press it on. Set the edge with blush so it never wears off.

scenes.title_en: Step Three: Smile Shape and a V on Top
scenes.context: 微微一笑，看到有阴影的地方，用一点腮红在阴影处轻轻扫出去，像微笑唇一样。上唇人中处画一个V字形，嘴巴更立体，边缘直接晕开。上下唇线画出来。语域：化妆教学，立体唇收尾。
sentences: 微微一笑，在阴影处扫一点腮红。
Smile slightly and sweep a touch of blush into the shadow.
sweep into the shadow（扫进阴影）
上唇人中处，画一个V字形。
Draw a small V at the philtrum of the upper lip.
philtrum（人中）
这样嘴巴就显得更立体。
That's how the lips look more three-dimensional.
three-dimensional（立体）
paraphrase: 微笑唇 → smile-shaped lips / a subtle smile look
人中 → philtrum / the upper-lip dip
scenes.speak: Smile slightly and sweep a touch of blush into the shadow. Draw a small V at the philtrum of the upper lip. That's how the lips look more three-dimensional.

practice: The moment it's revealed, you look ten years older.
Wait a minute, then rub off the flakes with a cotton swab.
Sweep the powder on thin — never press it on.
Draw a small V at the philtrum of the upper lip.
pitfalls: The lipstick is easy to fall color.
Smearing it on makes the color fade fast.
The look reads older from afar.
「远看显老」用 reads older from afar。
Never press it on — sweep it on thin.
「按压上粉」会显厚，用 sweep on thin。
Draw a V on the lip.
Draw a small V at the philtrum of the upper lip.
shifts: 用 smear（直接涂）、smack your lips（抿嘴）、blot（衬掉）
用 flakes and fine lines（死皮细纹）、reads older（显老）、fade（掉色）
用 sweep on thin（薄擦）、set with blush（腮红定妆）、V at the philtrum（人中画V）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：掉丝→掉色、一专案→一位专业、衬掉、巴得住、糊在一起变成一坨、上皮擦→像上粉太厚、微笑唇、人中、V字形、阴开→晕开等。
